archetype: Heritage Luxury meets Nautical Precision (Deep Navy + Burnished Copper + Handmade Paper/Ivory)
vibe: Human-crafted, bespoke financial advisory atelier with sacred Indian heritage & maritime navigational mastery. Replaces generic black-and-gold tech templates with organic tactile warmth, rich ink typography, and artisanal dignity.

theme_strategy.base_theme: Dual-Tone Heritage Architecture (Dark Deep Oceanic Navy for Hero/Intro/Footer & High-Impact Manifesto; Warm Textured Ivory/Handmade Parchment Paper for Analytical & Interactive Sections: About, Calculator, Comparison, Booking, Chapters).
theme_strategy.rationale: High-net-worth investors and families in India respect heritage, trust, and clarity. Complete dark feels like crypto gambling; complete flat white feels like SaaS template. The alternating parchment & midnight-navy rhythm creates a cinematic reading journey like unfolding an illuminated royal ledger.

logo_concept.direction: The Vedic Astrolabe & Navigational Compass Rose ('Satvik Yantra of Prosperity')
logo_concept.visual_motif: An intricate geometric SVG insignia merging the 8-pointed Lakshmi star (Ashta Lakshmi - 8 dimensions of enduring wealth) with a maritime navigator's astrolabe/sextant in burnished copper wireframe, holding a steady north star at its apex. It symbolizes navigating volatile market seas with ethical, disciplined equilibrium.
logo_concept.wordmark: SATVIK CAPITAL in Cormorant Garamond with wide tracking (tracking-[0.25em]), accompanied by a discreet subtitle 'WEALTH ARCHITECTURE & ADVISORY' in micro-mono uppercase.

intro_script_morph_experience.concept: The Hindu Traditional Multilingual Invocation ('One Dharma of Wealth, Eleven Voices')
intro_script_morph_experience.animation_flow: A sacred brass/copper circle pulses gently on a deep navy parchment canvas (#0B1528). The sacred scripts cycle rapidly yet ceremoniously with glowing copper typography (framer-motion AnimatePresence, duration 180ms each with subtle vertical drift). At the 10th transition, the copper compass logo resolves in golden-copper linework and expands into the stately wordmark 'SATVIK CAPITAL' accompanied by an auspicious Sanskrit tag line 'सत्येन धार्यते धनम्' (Wealth is preserved through discipline and truth).
intro_script_morph_experience.interaction: User can watch the 2.8s intro or click a tactile 'Enter Advisory / Skip' button in bottom right.

Three high-net-worth patron testimonials celebrating disciplined CAGR, crisis navigation, and the peace of mind of having Satvik's AMC-level insight.

Floating copper compass button in bottom-right that opens an intelligent conversational assistant capable of answering questions on Satvik's background, SIP mechanics, scheduling an audit, and connecting to Satvik directly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's rejection of generic black-and-gold templates; execute the 'Deep Navy (#0B1528) + Burnished Copper (#C76A3D) + Warm Paper/Parchment (#F9F6F0)' aesthetic.
Do NOT use pure Inter or Roboto for headers. Use Cormorant Garamond for regal titles and Manrope for razor-sharp, readable body text.

Implement the full Hindu-traditional script morph sequence at the first visit with smooth AnimatePresence and a skip option. The scripts: Devanagari (सात्विक), Kannada (ಸಾತ್ವಿಕ್), Tamil (சாத்விக்), Telugu (సాత్విక్), Bengali (সাত্ত্বিক), Gujarati (સાત્વિક), Malayalam (സാത്വിക്), Punjabi (ਸਾਤਵਿਕ), Odia (ସାତ୍ତ୍ୱିକ), Urdu (ساتوک), culminating in 'SATVIK CAPITAL'.
Highlight Satvik Kattimani's authentic edge: Bachelor's in Investment Banking + Hands-on Asset Management Company (AMC) Internship in Mutual Fund Ideation & Execution.
Direct contact channels (Phone: 9740542188, Email: satvikkinvestments@gmail.com, WhatsApp) must be prominent and celebrate 'Zero ticketing queues — talk directly to the advisor'.
Regulatory line 'AMFI-Registered Mutual Fund Distributor · ARN-349743' must appear ONLY in the footer near the copyright.

All interactive elements and form inputs MUST contain 'data-testid' tags (e.g., data-testid='book-audit-button', data-testid='sip-amount-slider', data-testid='phone-contact-link', data-testid='admin-login-button').
Provide a fully functional SIP Calculator with dynamic Recharts curve and realistic calculation formula.
Deliver an articulate 'Direct vs Regular Plan' educational comparison section showing why behavioral guidance and fund rebalancing beat lone DIY execution.
Provide a sleek floating AI Concierge dialog widget and a working Admin Dashboard view with appointments management and Google Calendar mock integration status.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (py-24, py-32 for sections, p-8 to p-12 for focal cards). Never let bordered containers touch text without padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_syndrome: Use asymmetric two-column layouts, editorial magazine offsets, and left-aligned structured typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Use framer-motion transitions with explicit ease and staggered delays. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure every text element has a minimum 4.5:1 contrast against its background. Invert text color explicitly on hover states.
